topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how somatic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and early cancer development.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate how tissue hierarchies, stemness properties, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences and inflammatory promotion
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how extrinsic microenvironmental signals and chronic inflammation act as promoters to facilitate malignant outgrowth and tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Technological approaches to studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It details the experimental and computational tools used to map mutational timing, cell states, and spatial architecture in tumors.

topics.label: Multifactorial model of cancer development and evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It provides a comprehensive synthesis integrating genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors in cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the concluding remarks and outlines the topic for the subsequent lecture.
